notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped regional interaction Time Regulation re-enable surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies that a queued timestamped region-qualified interaction remains correctly ordered across Time Regulation disable and re-enable with a changed lookahead, that Query Lookahead and time-regulation callbacks agree with the standard state, that constrained grants deliver the preserved source-region metadata and interaction metadata, and that retraction, region, declaration, federation, and connection cleanup complete without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped regional interaction, Time Regulation disable/re-enable, Query Lookahead, time advance, retraction, and cleanup services with FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction(time), timeRegulationEnabled, and timeAdvanceGrant delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped regional interaction and time regulation declarations
